abstract: During the last 11 years, 144 nonlymphoreticular neoplasms were diagnosed in exfoliative cytology specimens obtained from patients younger than 17 years of age. Neuroblastoma was the single most common neoplasm (30 cases). Other categories of malignant neoplasms were primary bone tumors (30 cases), soft-tissue sarcomas (25 cases), brain tumors (25 cases) and epithelial neoplasms (7 cases). Of the 780 cytologic specimens, 335 were positive for malignant cells. Serous effusions provided most of the positive specimens from patients with neuroblastoma, germ-cell tumors and bone sarcomas. Exfoliated cells of metastatic embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma and primary brain tumors were detected most often in cerebrospinal fluid specimens. A most unusual presentation of an immature teratoma of the ovary is described in some detail. Despite the rarity of pediatric neoplasms, certain specific or suggestive cytologic features were recognized, including rosette formation of neuroblasts, nuclear notching of myoblasts, pleomorphism of osteoblasts and fibrillar processes of glial elements.
abstract_ja: 過去11年間に、17歳未満の患者から得られた剥離細胞診検体で144例の非リンパ網内系腫瘍が診断された。神経芽腫が最も多い単独の腫瘍であった(30例)。他の悪性腫瘍の分類には、原発性骨腫瘍(30例)、軟部肉腫(25例)、脳腫瘍(25例)、上皮性腫瘍(7例)が含まれた。780の細胞診検体のうち335例が悪性細胞陽性であった。神経芽腫、胚細胞腫瘍、骨肉腫の患者では、陽性検体の大部分が漿膜腔液に由来していた。転移性横紋筋肉腫および原発性脳腫瘍の剥離細胞は、髄液検体で最も多く検出された。卵巣の未熟奇形腫の非常に珍しい提示例について、詳細に記述する。小児腫瘍は稀であるにもかかわらず、神経芽腫のロゼット形成、横紋筋芽細胞の核の切れ込み、骨芽細胞の多形性、グリア成分の線維状突起など、特異的または示唆的な細胞学的特徴が認められた。
